title: The Taking
author: Dean Koontz
note: conf=0.95; 2004 horror/suspense novel by Dean Koontz (Bantam Books). ISBN 9780553593501 is the Bantam/Random House mass market paperback edition, confirmed via Penguin Random House and Books-A-Million. No source (Wikipedia, publisher, Kirkus, TV Tropes) associates it with any series; it is a genuine standalone, distinct from Koontz's Odd Thomas or Frankenstein series.
